steps: (c) true: at most one obtuse angle
check_code:
from fractions import Fraction as F
import itertools
angs=[(a,b,180-a-b) for a in range(1,179) for b in range(1,180-a)]
ta=all(sum(t)==180 for t in angs)
tb=not any(t[0]==t[1]==t[2] for t in angs)
tc=all(sum(x>90 for x in t)<=1 for t in angs)
td=False  # strict triangle inequality: a+b>c always, never equal for a real triangle
truth={'a':ta,'b':tb,'c':tc,'d':td}
r=frozenset(k for k,v in truth.items() if v)
opts = {'A': frozenset('ab'), 'B': frozenset('abd'), 'C': frozenset('ac'), 'D': frozenset('bcd')}
assert r == opts['C']
assert r != opts['A']
assert r != opts['B']
assert r != opts['D']

from fractions import Fraction as F
d=(1-F(3,4)**2)*100
i=(F(5,4)**2-1)*100
r=round(float((i-d)/i*100),2)
opts = {'A': 50.0, 'B': 22.22, 'C': 43.75, 'D': 56.25}
assert r == opts['B']
assert r != opts['A']
assert r != opts['C']
assert r != opts['D']
